'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male [[Lollo Logistics]] [[NPC]], who is actually an [[Outcasts|Outcast]] in disguise, seen trying to extract information from '''Halberg'''. They can be found outside the Academy at night while the '''real Esson''' is located nearby [[Atuja Camp]] [[Resonance Nexus|{{tt|Solis Lens Array|Resonance Nexus}}]] and is unfortunately mistaken as the Outcast.

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Esson:''' Chief, I still don't get it. Just how many procedures does external cargo need to get into [[Lahai-Roi]]?
:'''Halberg:''' Plenty! First, everything goes to our headquarters.
:'''Esson:''' Right, centralized management. Got it.
:'''Halberg:''' Then the most crucial step—inspection and quarantine. Nothing gets in or out of Lahai-Roi without being tested and verified.
:'''Esson:''' Right, check the cargo. Got it.
:'''Halberg:''' Only then can it board the Lollo Logistics ship and land at the frostlands port.
:'''Esson:''' Right, switch to land transport. Got it.
:'''Halberg:''' Finally, the downward express of the [[Starward Riseway]], straight from the frostlands to the Institute and Academy.
:'''Halberg:''' Now, repeat it.
:'''Esson:''' Uh... well...
:'''Halberg:''' Wait... you're not a spy, are you? That procedure applies to people too!
:'''"Esson":''' Tch...
:{{DIcon}} He's an Outcast in disguise.
:'''Halberg:''' Oh no! Then where's the real Esson?! Support staff! SUPPORT STAFF!!
----
;The Real Esson
:;Behave yourself! Try any funny business, and this won't end well for you!
:;Stay sharp. We've no idea what tricks that traitor's still hiding.
:;I'll contact the Academy for backup!
:;'''Esson''' Hey, hey! Stop hitting me! These clothes aren't even mine!
:;'''Esson''' I woke up and my uniform and Terminal were gone...
:;'''Esson''' Oh right! My badge! Esson, Lollo Logistics, ID 89757!
:;'''Esson''' Why do I keep waking up and getting beaten up...? Sniff sniff...
{{Dialogue End}}
